# Microcopy matrix — [Business]

Save as content/microcopy-matrix.md and reference it from the brand-voice
skill. Interface copy is a system; this is the system written down.

| State | Tone | Max length | Rule | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Success | Brief, warm | 8 words | Name what happened. No exclamation marks. | Booking confirmed for Tuesday 10:00. |
| Error — empty required field | Calm, directive | 12 words | Name the field and what to add. | Add your email so we can send the confirmation. |
| Error — invalid input | Calm, directive | 15 words | Say what a valid value looks like. | That email is missing an @. Check and try again. |
| Error — server / unknown | Calm, honest | 20 words | Say it is on our side and what to do now. | Something went wrong on our side. Your details are safe; try again in a minute. |
| Empty state | Inviting | 15 words | One action the person can take now. | No bookings yet. Make your first one. |
| Loading | Neutral | 5 words | Say what is loading. | Checking availability |
| Confirmation (destructive) | Plain | 25 words | What will happen, what cannot be undone; button names the action. | This cancels Tuesday's booking and cannot be undone. [Cancel booking] [Keep booking] |
| Helper text | Plain | 12 words | Why we ask, or the format expected. | We only use this to send your confirmation. |
| Button, primary | — | 3 words | Says the action. Sentence case. | Book a call |
| Button, secondary | — | 3 words | Says the alternative. | Keep editing |
| Tooltip | Plain | 10 words | One fact. No "click here". | Shown on your public profile |
| Notification | Brief | 12 words | What happened and, if needed, one link. | Your invoice is ready. View it |

Rules that apply to every row:
- An action keeps its name through the flow: "Publish" button → "Published" message.
- Numbers and dates in the format the person entered them.
- Never "Oops", "Whoops", "Something's not right".
- Greek column: add after native review; see content/glossary-el.md.
